decisions.reason: As a multi-model flagship range presented publicly as central to the firm's innovation direction, the waterproof line has heavy sunk development investment and visible commitment, so management would attribute any weakness to temporary pandemic effects and persist.

The ESD shoe is close to the core offer and meets standard workplace requirements, so keeping it costs little, though as a single, less visible model it is more exposed to range rationalization than the lines.

The safety shoe series is a multi-model line embedded in the established portfolio and trade channels, so the investment and channel commitments favor continuing it, possibly with model refreshes rather than withdrawal.
